items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: You remember the thing we did in Detroit? I went out and got Tommy Gamble... Jackie had the Presidential Suite... We said, well, we'll just go... Jackie said, 'I've got $300 worth of barbecue!'

ctx.x: We had such a ball! The DeMarco Sisters - what was that guy's name, Stan something, a very funny guy -

A comedian that did all the parts. Then you remember that Jackie would always say, "Milt, didn't you fix the coffee?" and if he didn't get that coffee, that was it. Jackie at that particular time had a weight problem.
He contributed a great deal to jazz, didn't he?
